### 2026-10-06 – Today I fully designed my pcb I had some prior experience from the hack club, hackpad project which I did not complete. I was able to finish the schematic pretty quickly. After finishing that about 40

**1.5h**

Today I fully designed my pcb I had some prior experience from the hack club, hackpad project which I did not complete. I was able to finish the schematic pretty quickly. After finishing that about 40% of my time was spent trying to figure out why my footprint library wasn't working. I ended up figuring it out but it did take a while.

### 2026-10-07 – ![one](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/VUsqYsJQU3oaQ5M5MTZACBI7uSlmkXMr/283d516904a22c3901fd4b281fc68a3ead6f929e0c057fab74beb42b3cb47651.jpg)

**2h**

![one](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/VUsqYsJQU3oaQ5M5MTZACBI7uSlmkXMr/283d516904a22c3901fd4b281fc68a3ead6f929e0c057fab74beb42b3cb47651.jpg)

Today I began working on my code for the macro pad. After working on that for 30 minutes, I checked in with a friend and they pointed out a flaw in my PCB design I was originally trying to save space by overlapping two of the parts/footprints, but it wasn't going to work out in the end. So they pointed that out to me, and I ended up fixing it. I also did not have a border/edge cut for my PCB, so I ended up also doing that. We also checked in about my code, and they said it looked fine to them.
